resources.most_of_the_peak_is_one_check: REV 53 S0.3's control inflates the process past the 700 MB fixture budget ON PURPOSE and frees it immediately -- it has to exceed that budget to reproduce the case. That is why the peak is ~850 MB and the RETAINED figure is ~26 MB, and why the peak cannot be reduced without retiring the control

battery_scope.why: a REAL day runs the FULL battery -- the four R6 controls and all 101 day-path checks -- because the run is already reading the ledger (reviewer S3.4). THIS COUNT IS COMPUTED: it read a literal 23 beside a constant of 38 and then 49, which is rule 10 in my own receipt
battery_scope.why_not_at_the_emit: it WAS at the emit. On 2026-09-03 the day's 84 minutes finished and a FIXTURE check inside the battery refused on the real day's process-wide high-water; nothing was written and the day was lost. The budget defect is fixed (growth, per stage), but the ORDER was the other half: a check that can refuse must refuse before the work it would waste. Measured by `before_work.residency.day_draws_when_the_hook_returned`, which is 0

requirements.lock_inside_the_unit: `flock -n` is the unit's own ExecStart, so a held lock exits 1 INSIDE the unit and the payload never starts -- read `ExecMainStatus`, never assume it started

launch_form_at_runtime.the_exemption_is_the_GATE: not a report beside it: `fixture=True` alone used to admit a REAL DAY NAME (REV 68 S1.2)
launch_form_at_runtime.the_real_day_predicate_is_POSITIVE: refuse unless kind == 'transient service'. The negative test `kind == 'scope'` FAILED OPEN on kind None and on an empty observation (REV 68 S1.3)
launch_form_at_runtime.why_checked_may_be_false: an unknown kind is not a passed check. It used to admit a real day AND claim `checked` true

lock_form_at_runtime.identity_from: /proc/<ppid>/exe -- the file the kernel mapped, never argv[0], which `exec -a` sets to anything
lock_form_at_runtime.why_runtime_not_the_lint: the lint reads the string a builder produced; this reads what actually ran. `-E` is what makes a held lock readable from a crash (REV 69 S1.2)

memory_plan.budget_is_on_GROWTH_not_the_process_peak: ru_maxrss never falls, so a fixture day run inside a real day's process inherits that day's peak. It cost the 09-03 smoke 85 minutes: the day's work finished and the emit-time battery refused its own fixture on the real day's high-water
memory_plan.growth_is_process_history_dependent: a warm process grows less than a cold one -- the allocator already holds what an earlier run took. The REAL day runs in a FRESH process, which is the regime the 4000 MB budget is derived against

index_splits.consequence_for_BEs_assembly: the index is needed only to PRODUCE `asm`. It does not have to be resident alongside the reference and `asm` at all, because the consumer of those two is a different process. If BE releases the index before assembling and writing the book, the whole-day peak is max(index stage, assembly stage) rather than their sum
index_splits.falsifier: a book whose `asm` lacks a pinned head REFUSES naming that head; a run with no tape artifact reachable at all still completes
index_splits.measured_by: day_split_residency_proof() -- the day path run under instrumentation, asserting no tape/index/fragment artifact was opened

per_stage.S0b_battery: no split. The battery reads BE's committed null receipt and the ledger -- declared reads, none of them a tape, index or fragment artifact -- and it runs under its OWN residency instrument, whose opens are SUBTRACTED from the day path's claim so that claim stays about the day path (R-610)
per_stage.S2_population: no split. `asm['by_arm'][(coin, head)][0]` IS the scored set; the scorer is a dict lookup that REFUSES on a miss rather than computing a feature
per_stage.S3_baseline_and_S4_null: no split. Each replay values its fills from the fill record and the reference; per WINDOW and streamable, with nothing accumulated across draws
per_stage.economics_valuation: no split, and NOT per-window-resident either -- one fill list at a time

index_splits.question: which tape-index splits must be resident during `--day`, and at which stage
index_splits.what_DE_cannot_rule: WHICH split BE must build to produce a September day's `asm` is BE's measurement and R-496(E)'s ruling, not DE's. What is declared here is only what the CONSUMER needs, which is the half BE was waiting on
index_splits.why: the decision population is read from `asm` -- BE's already assembled per-generation scores, keyed (slug, side, t0) -- and the economics valuation reads only the replay's own fill records and the reference's levels and markouts (`de_phase4_diag_runner.fill_value_cents`). Neither touches a tape row

peak_stage.binds_on_a_real_day_only: on a real day the book dominates (BE: 2.008 GB reference) and S1 being the peak is what the 8 GiB ceiling rests on, so a disagreement REFUSES the day. On a fixture the book is a few hundred KB and the draw loop's fixed cost is larger, so the measured peak is S4_null -- recorded, not refused, and design v9 stated the claim flatly where it should have stated the condition
peak_stage.why_the_DELTA_is_the_peak: a transient a stage allocates and frees before its mark is invisible to the current-RSS series and VISIBLE in the highwater delta, because the highwater recorded it and never came down. The delta is what attributes growth to a stage
peak_stage.why_the_hook_is_not_in_the_argmax: the `before_work` hook is the BATTERY, not the day path. Its high-water is a transient it frees before returning (measured 838 MB peak, 26 MB retained); the 8 GiB ceiling rests on the DAY PATH's shape, and letting a freed transient win the argmax would refuse a day over a stage the ceiling does not rest on. Its delta is computed, reported, and counted in the day's GROWTH BUDGET -- only the argmax excludes it
peak_stage.why_two_instruments: the highwater bounds the process and can never fall; the current-RSS series can, so it is the only one that can locate a peak

stages.holds: digests only: BE's builder receipt, the book's bytes, the pinned models and thetas, BE's cascade module. The book is READ ONCE here as bytes for its digest and the buffer is handed to S1, never read twice (BE's B-1)

THE IN-RUN BATTERY, MOVED HERE FROM THE EMIT (R-610). It ran AFTER the day's work: ~15 s of fixture runs and a 13-module closure re-capture at the end of 85 minutes, and if it refused, the day was lost -- which is exactly what happened to the 09-03 smoke. Its memory is INSIDE the day's growth budget on purpose: a stage whose cost escapes the budget is a stage nobody bounded

[DECLARED PEAK] reference + asm + rows. THE PEAK OF THE DAY PATH WHEN THE BOOK DOMINATES -- which is the real-day regime (BE measured a day's reference at 2.008 GB) and is NOT true on a small fixture: on the synthetic book, measured, the peak is S4_null, because the draw loop's fixed cost is larger than a few hundred KB of book. The claim is CONDITIONAL, the condition is stated, and it is ASSERTED on a real day -- where the 8 GiB ceiling rests on it
adds one score float per generation per arm, twice. asm's gen_scores are ALREADY resident from S1; the arm stream is a view over `rows`
adds the no-cancel replay's fills -- the neutral reference path (CLAUDE.md reliability rule 1)
one draw's flags and one replayed fill list AT A TIME. The draws are REDUCED to a value each as they are made; no draw's fills survive the next. O(1) in n_draws
counts and statuses only. The economic fields are computed and withheld, never carried into the artifact

split_residency_proof.py_sources_excluded_on_purpose: `pm_tape_density.py` is a MODULE whose name contains 'tape'; matching it would make the proof fire on its own imports
split_residency_proof.the_claim_is_about: the DAY PATH: the whole-process set MINUS the before_work hook's own set. Both are reported, so the subtraction is auditable
split_residency_proof.why_that_second_field_exists: the capped list is what the ARTIFACT carries and the uncapped set is what the QUESTION is asked of. When they disagree the cap bit, and a reader can see that it did rather than wondering why a 200-entry list does not contain the book
split_residency_proof.why_truncation_does_not_hide_a_hit: the tape scan reads `data_paths_opened`, which is NOT capped, in union with the capped list -- every marker lives under `data/`

what_this_is_not.D_E_MINUS_R_is_UNBOUND: the robustness endpoint needs the rebate's identity value, which is NOT on DE's surface. D(E0) -- the DECLARED PRIMARY -- is computed here from `de_phase4_diag_runner.fill_value_cents`, which is level-to-markout with NO fee term and therefore IS the E0 endpoint. D(E-R) is not computed and is not approximated

the_seal_scope_in_force_for_THIS_receipt.generated_from: ECONOMIC_FIELDS and SEALED_FROM_DESIGN_VERSION -- the map the emitter actually applied, read at emit
the_seal_scope_in_force_for_THIS_receipt.the_open_sizes_are: the action-side counts rule 8 requires and what R4's admissibility bar reads. `n_decisions` cannot be sealed without making the bar uncheckable
the_seal_scope_in_force_for_THIS_receipt.the_sealed_outcome_counts_are: counts of what the policy DID: arm fills MINUS baseline fills is the intervention's effect in events (R-659)
the_seal_scope_in_force_for_THIS_receipt.why_generated: a literal list here said four counts were open SIZES while the emitter sealed three of them (R-674). A receipt that describes its own seal from a constant somebody edited separately describes a different seal

work_counters.why_deltas: the battery runs FIXTURE days and those draw; a process-wide counter would credit the day with the battery's work

wrapper.a_SHARED_hold_does_not_satisfy_rule_20: rule 20 is ONE heavy run at a time. `flock -s` lets two holders in at once, and both would have read `held: true` under the previous two-conjunct test (REV 41)
wrapper.declared_wrapper_is_not_evidence: params carries a `wrapper` string; a string in a file cannot say what launched this process (R-575(C))

fresh_probe.why_two: a shared hold blocks an exclusive request and admits a shared one; only an exclusive hold blocks both. Rule 20 needs exclusivity

wrapper.how: a fresh-fd LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB that FAILS, AND a /proc/locks FLOCK entry on the lock's inode whose pid is this process or an ancestor -- the holder is the `flock` wrapper, not the python child
wrapper.lock_fd_is_corroboration_not_the_test: an fd on the lock file says the file is OPEN. Two lines of `open()` with no flock forged the old field, and a 1-hour / 6.84 GiB run certified itself (reviewer §2.3)
